name: Reka Nexus
desc: Platform for creating and managing AI workers for enterprises
desc_zh: 帮助企业创建和管理 AI 数字员工的平台
solves: Routine workflows wait for scarce staff; Nexus lets a business spin up AI workers that run them.
solves_zh: 重复流程常因人手不足而搁置，Nexus 让企业派出 AI 员工去执行。
best_for: A support queue doubles overnight and hiring will take a quarter to fix.
best_for_zh: 客服工单一夜之间翻倍，而招到人至少还要等上一个季度。
